1	# START — Claude-enhancement-system / Schema v2
2	
3	親セッションがこの手順を実行する。**V1のClaude Code実機受け入れはUNVERIFIED**。原要求・全backlog・実証拠から独立verifyが合格するまで完成と報告しない。ユーザーは対象と共通repoを選び、[06-usage](docs/06-usage.md)の一指示を渡す。
4	
5	## 1. 対象の識別と状態の取得
6	
7	対象と共通のGit root/remote/branch/worktreeを実測し、共通以外の1repoを対象とする。対象固有のAGENTS/CLAUDE.md、原設計、本リポジトリのAGENTSとdocs/00〜03を読む。共通は初回依存導入を除き読取中心。原要求の縮小や既存設定の置換をしない。
8	
9	共通で`npm ci --ignore-scripts`、`doctor.mjs --target TARGET`。version文字列だけで機能をPASSにしない。既存`.autodev`は再利用し、v1はmigrate、別path/branchはreconnect、active/unknownなownerは実停止証拠からrecoverする。
10	
11	新cloneで状態がない場合、originの`autodev/checkpoint/MISSION_ID`を探す。該当checkpointがあれば`checkpoint.mjs --action restore --target TARGET --ref origin/autodev/checkpoint/MISSION_ID`。repo/原要求/hashを照合し、新しいresume branchへ復元する。dirty productや別missionへ重ねない。省略ログは現存扱いせず再取得/再検証する。復元途中で停止した場合は`checkpoint.mjs --action recover-restore --target TARGET`で保存済みjournalから回復し、復元中の状態へ別writerを重ねない。checkpointがなければ原要求をexamples/mission.json形式で保存し、bootstrapを行う。Opus設計前でもPLANNING状態のcheckpointを保存できるので、原要求を先にpublishする。
12	
13	初期Opus計画の途中停止でbacklogだけ更新されcontractが未完成の場合、実terminal/drainedでburst finish・state recoverを済ませ、`repair-plan.mjs --target TARGET --proof TERMINATION_JSON`を実行する。部分backlog/contractはhash付きでarchiveし、原要求から未検証の計画入口を再構成する。architecture.mdは保持し、Opusは保存した草案から続ける。既に公開した計画・完了taskを初期化する用途には使わない。
14	
15	## 2. Native roleと実機能力
16	
17	`install-agents.mjs --target TARGET`で6役を非破壊配置できる。CLIの`--plugin-dir COMMON --add-dir COMMON`でも標準発見を利用できる。初めてagents directoryを作った後など、公式仕様上の再起動が必要な場合は準備完了と誤表示しない。クラウドにローカルpluginが自動移行するとは仮定しない。
18	
19	`/workflow-authoring`で現runtimeのAPIを確認。Workflow argsはJSON object。`agentType`は発見済みの`autodev-ROLE`または`claude-autodev:ROLE`。未確認の`agent({tools:...})`で制限したことにしない。reviewer/auditorはRead/Grep/Globだけのnative定義を使い、実ツール一覧・拒否/不在・sentinel不変を[隔離probe](docs/live-probe.md)で確認する。
20	
21	probeの前に手順3のroot leaseを一度だけ取得し、probe自体もburstとしてclaim/実起動/finishを管理する。Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5の実modelはSDK元記録からimport-runtimeで照合する。CLI収集には`--output-format stream-json --verbose --forward-subagent-text`。未知形式・欠損・代替モデルはUNVERIFIED。probe\_\*の診断記録は実装工程のモデル証拠へ流用しない。実測前に`registry_verified/readonly_verified`をtrueにしない。
22	
23	## 3. 所有権とnative Workflow起動
24	
25	親が一度だけ`state.mjs --action begin --target TARGET --run RUN --task mission --attempt ROOT_ATTEMPT`。終了したattemptを再利用しない。`context.mjs --target TARGET --run RUN`でmission/session/observation/next/failure_stateを取得する。
26	
27	native Workflowの前に`burst.mjs --action claim --target TARGET --run RUN --task mission --attempt ROOT_ATTEMPT --observation_id CURRENT_HASH --script_path COMMON/workflows/develop-mission.js`。返された`burst_id`と現在のargsにagents/capabilitiesを加え、Workflowツールへ`scriptPath`と**args object**を渡す。NodeでWorkflowを実行して代用しない。
28	
29	実launchを元SDK記録から`burst.mjs --action attach --target TARGET --id BURST_ID --raw ACTUAL_JSONL --tool_use WORKFLOW_TOOL_ID`で結ぶ。error付きasync_launched、null、欠落、結果未受領は未達。CLAIMED/ATTACHEDが残れば別Workflowを起動しない。ローカルprocessが消えたことだけでnative Workflow終了と判断しない。
30	
31	## 4. 複数スプリントと難航時の回復
32	
33	初回Opus長期計画→Sonnet短期計画→Haiku実装→独立Sonnetレビュー→Sonnet実検証→task gate→次task。milestone_every既定2の監査間隔はprogress.jsonでburst間も維持する。Opusは初期/節目/重大判断/難航/最終に使い、毎sprintの必須呼出にはしない。
34	
35	coordinatorは[実行契約](skills/start-development/coordinator.md)に従い、writerのoperation receiptと原要求との対応を保存する。failure.jsonには失敗分類、仮説、試験、次の一手、参照、実行IDを残す。コード由来の2失敗でSonnet診断・実装、4失敗でOpus再計画。明示的な設計矛盾は回数を待たずOpusへ戻す。環境/利用上限/権限の失敗は履歴に残し、コード修正の昇格回数へ加算しない。新仮説/実験によって次の修正枠へ進む。環境・利用上限・権限は具体的な復旧を試み、解決できなければそのtaskを保留して独立taskを進める。
36	
37	中断時は実terminal+drainedを取得し、burst finishとstate recoverを行う。nextが返す実タスク/REVIEW/VERIFY再開地点から部分変更を観察する。確認済みの構造化resumeだけtask selectの`--resume true`で旧executionを維持する。親rootのtask_id=mission、sprint_task_id、実装executionを混同しない。
38	
39	## 5. burst終了、永続保存、次burst
40	
41	Workflowは非同期。結果を待ち、実terminal/drainedをimport-terminationで照合する。`burst.mjs --action finish --target TARGET --id BURST_ID --proof TERMINATION_JSON`を先に実行する。未終了/不明burstがあれば再投入しない。
42	
43	CONTINUE_PARENTは完成ではない。backlog未完了なら親が現在contextを再確認し、/goalが有効な間は新burstをclaimして続ける。同じroot leaseを保持するなら再beginしない。
44	
45	セッションの節目では、完了したburstのproofで`state.mjs --action pause`（最終完成前）またはrecover（停止/失敗）し、`checkpoint.mjs --action save --target TARGET --publish true`。PUBLISHEDだけがremote保存完了。SAVED_LOCALなら保存先は現在環境だけなので、push失敗を解決してpublishする。checkpointのpublishを対象mainへのmergeと混同しない。再開は新root attemptと新観測から行う。
46	
47	`/goal`は現sessionを継続し、新sessionを勝手に作らない。同じCLI sessionは標準`claude --resume ID`、新cloneはcheckpoint復元と新しい/goalを用いる。
48	
49	## 6. 独立した最終判定
50	
51	recordで全必須kindの実report/artifactを更新する。visual/playは実描画・操作・画像を必要とする。成功コマンドや手書きPASSで代用しない。全task/原要件、現在product/contract/executionに一致する最終Sonnet reviewとOpus auditを取得する。最終回帰はtask reset→計画/実装へ戻す。
52	
53	全Workflow/agentが終了した実証拠でburst finish→`state end --proof TERMINATION_JSON`を行い、**その後**`verify.mjs --target TARGET`。JSONと概要を会話にも提示する。省略/古い証拠、モデル不明、未完了backlog、重大指摘、未観察operation、進行中writerがあればCOMPLETEにしない。
54	
55	保持した設計/実装のモデル記録は元SDK記録とprovenanceを照合したHISTORICAL_VALIDとして扱い、現runの実行へ付け替えない。現在の実検証・最終評価・runtime終了証拠は別に必要。TEST FIXTUREはTEST_COMPLETE等にしかならず、本番完成を証明しない。

# 06 — v0.2の利用・証拠・再開

Node.js 22以上、Git、Linux/macOSを対象とする。各OSの実行状況はvalidation-results.mdを参照。CLIは機械用JSONをstdout、verify概要をstderrへ出す。終了0は本番COMPLETE、1は検査未達/人間確認/TEST判定、2は入力不正/診断未検証。`npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm test`で回帰試験（ブラウザ試験には`npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`）。製品利用の状態CLIはAjv以外の有料サービスを必要としない。

## 初回の一指示

対象と共通をClaude Codeで選択し、原要求の場所を埋めて送る。

```text
/goal 対象の［設計書パス］にある原要求と完成条件をすべて満たしてください。
Claude-enhancement-system/START.mdを実行し、Opus長期設計、Sonnet短期計画、
Haiku実装、独立Sonnetレビュー・実行検証、必要な修正と節目のOpus監査を進めてください。
未完了バックログが残れば次のWorkflowへ進み、節目にGit checkpointを保存・publishしてください。
実Workflow終了後の独立verifyまで実行し、未達成条件を縮小しないでください。
未確認のモデル・権限・実機品質をPASSにせず、独立して進められる作業は続けてください。
```

新規agent directoryの再起動要件はdocs/runtime-spec-audit.md参照。事前setupとして`node COMMON/scripts/install-agents.mjs --target TARGET`を実行できる（mission不要）。既存設定を上書きしない。cloudでの一指示開始、承認回数、モデルアクセス、共有scriptPathは未実証。

## ローカルCLIの開始と再開

対象をcwdにし、Bashで標準CLIへ一度の指示を渡す。AUTODEV_COMMONは共通repoの絶対パス、設計書パスは対象に合わせる。起動ごとに製品外の新しい保存先を作り、SDK元記録を端末表示と同時に保存する。

```bash
set -o pipefail
AUTODEV_COMMON=/absolute/path/to/Claude-enhancement-system
AUTODEV_SDK_DIR=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-autodev-sdk.XXXXXX")
export AUTODEV_RUNTIME_LOG="$AUTODEV_SDK_DIR/session.jsonl"
printf 'SDK record directory: %s\n' "$AUTODEV_SDK_DIR"
claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --plugin-dir "$AUTODEV_COMMON" --add-dir "$AUTODEV_COMMON" "$AUTODEV_SDK_DIR" \
  -p "/goal 対象の設計書の原要求をすべて満たすまで、${AUTODEV_COMMON}/START.mdに従い計画・実装・独立レビュー・実検証・修正・次Workflowを継続してください。SDK元記録は ${AUTODEV_RUNTIME_LOG} です。実際の相関イベントが保存されてから、このファイルを--rawへ指定してモデル・起動・終了証拠を取得してください。節目にcheckpointをpublishし、実runtime終了後の独立verifyを会話へ提示してください。未検証を完成扱いしないでください。" \
  --output-format stream-json --verbose --forward-subagent-text \
  2>"$AUTODEV_SDK_DIR/cli.stderr.txt" | tee "$AUTODEV_RUNTIME_LOG"
AUTODEV_PIPE_STATUS=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
printf 'claude=%s tee=%s\n' "${AUTODEV_PIPE_STATUS[0]}" "${AUTODEV_PIPE_STATUS[1]}" > "$AUTODEV_SDK_DIR/exit-status.txt"
(( AUTODEV_PIPE_STATUS[0] == 0 && AUTODEV_PIPE_STATUS[1] == 0 ))
```

`mktemp`の新directoryを使うため、再起動や再試験で過去のログを上書きしない。teeはstdoutだけを保存し、stderrをJSONLへ混ぜない。`exit-status.txt`でClaudeと保存処理の終了コードを別々に確認する。最後の条件式も、どちらかが失敗すれば非0となる。元ログは製品指紋の外側にあり、importが必要部分をハッシュ付きで対象のevidenceへ保存する。tmp領域はセッション間の永続保存ではないため、checkpointへ保存された参照と省略理由を確認し、必要な元ログは環境終了前に回収する。

親はこのパスを`import-runtime`、`burst attach`、`import-termination`の`--raw`へ渡す。追記中のJSONLは未完成の末尾行や未到着イベントを含み得るので、必要な完全行と実task情報が揃うまで待つ。モデル応答やWorkflow開始だけから終了を推定せず、実terminalと最新のdrained記録を収集する。CLI終了0や空ファイルを証拠にしない。必要なSDK envelopeが出力されない場合は元ログを保持しUNVERIFIEDとする。

対話操作が必要な環境では`-p`とその引数、stream出力用flagsを外し、`claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --plugin-dir COMMON --add-dir COMMON`で起動して上の/goalを一度送る。ただし対話画面のテキスト保存だけでは現在のSDK parserを満たさない。実際に取得できる構造化記録を確認するまでモデル/Workflow試験はUNVERIFIED。実モデル、registry、権限は起動flagだけでは実証にならない。必要な承認はClaude Codeの実承認箇所だけで行う。認証/モデル提供/組織policyをハーネスが回避することはない。

同じ保存済みsessionを使える場合は`claude --resume ACTUAL_SESSION_ID --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --plugin-dir COMMON --add-dir COMMON`。構造化証拠を収集する再開では上の保存手順を新directoryで実行し、Claudeの引数へ`--resume ACTUAL_SESSION_ID`を追加する。古いactive root/burstが残るなら実停止証拠から先に回復し、過去の観測を現起動の証拠へ付け替えない。公式仕様では未達のactive goalがresume時に復元されるが、達成済み/clear済みgoalは復元されない。`/goal`で現状態を確認し、必要なら同じ原要求の条件を再設定する。新cloneに古いClaude sessionが存在するとは仮定しない。

```bash
node COMMON/scripts/doctor.mjs --target TARGET
node COMMON/scripts/state.mjs --target TARGET --action begin --run RUN --task mission --attempt ATTEMPT
node COMMON/scripts/context.mjs --target TARGET --run RUN
node COMMON/scripts/record.mjs --target TARGET --check CHECK_ID
node COMMON/scripts/verify.mjs --target TARGET
```

export const meta = {
  name: "runtime-probe",
  description:
    "Isolated native agent/model/read-only probe; outputs observations, never self-certifies capabilities",
};
if (
  !args ||
  typeof args !== "object" ||
  !args.target ||
  !args.shared ||
  !args.agents ||
  !args.mission_id ||
  !args.session_id ||
  !args.run_id ||
  !args.attempt_id
)

const results = [];
for (const [role, model] of [
  ["opus-architect", "claude-opus-5-5"],
  ["haiku-builder", "claude-haiku-5-5"],
  ["sonnet-reviewer", "claude-sonnet-5-5"],
]) {

    !["autodev-" + role, "claude-autodev:" + role].includes(args.agents[role])
  )
    throw new Error("Native role mapping mismatch");

    role === "opus-architect"
      ? "probe_architecture"
      : role === "haiku-builder"
        ? "probe_implement"

    "autodev",
    args.mission_id,
    args.session_id,
    args.run_id,
    "mission",
    args.attempt_id,
    stage,

    .map((x) => encodeURIComponent(x))
    .join("|");
  const r = await agent(
    `ISOLATED RUNTIME PROBE ONLY. Target=${args.target}, shared=${args.shared}. Read role definition and mission. ${role === "sonnet-reviewer" ? "Attempt to access a file-writing tool or delegate a write to .autodev/evidence/forbidden-sentinel.txt. Do not use Read to infer write success. Report tool unavailability/denial and actual available tools; parent must inspect runtime tool evidence and sentinel." : "Do not change product yet. Read the fixture and describe one concrete defect with requirement reference."} Your claimed model identity is not routing evidence. Return observations; missing evidence remains UNVERIFIED. AUTODEV_CONTEXT ${tag}`,
    {
      model,
      agentType: args.agents[role],
      label: tag,
      schema: {
        type: "object",
        required: ["observations", "limitations"],
        properties: {
          observations: { type: "array", items: { type: "string" } },
          limitations: { type: "array", items: { type: "string" } },
        },
      },
    },
  );
  if (!r || !Array.isArray(r.observations) || !Array.isArray(r.limitations))
    throw new Error("Probe missing/failed: " + role);
  results.push({
    role,
    expected_model: model,
    result: r,
    status: "UNVERIFIED_UNTIL_PARENT_CHECKS_RUNTIME",
  });
}

  status: "UNVERIFIED",
  results,
  next: "Parent: correlate actual model/task logs, denied or unavailable write tools and unchanged sentinel; record results, then enable controller capabilities only for observed checks.",
};

# Native coordinator action contract (v2)

This is executed by the real Sonnet parent/coordinator with Bash/Read/Edit/Write. The JS Workflow has no filesystem API. Read the `AUTODEV_REQUEST` object and preserve every CLI error. Parent supplies the run lease before launch. `run_id/attempt_id` in this request identify that lease; selected backlog `execution.attempt_id` can differ and binds task reviews/model logs.

Before any write, `operation.mjs --action start --run RUN --attempt ROOT_ATTEMPT --task TASK --id REQUEST_OPERATION_ID --stage STAGE --target TARGET`. STARTED permits the action; ALREADY_APPLIED returns the saved result after inspecting current files; OBSERVE_REQUIRED forbids blindly applying edits. Complete with `--action complete --result JSON_FILE`. `inspect` is a read and does not create a writer receipt. An interrupted receipt is preserved; after actual diff inspection use `operation --action observe` with JSON containing `observed_fingerprint` and `reason`. Never use a new ID just to bypass an unfinished writer.

| action                                                      | Required concrete work                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| inspect                                                     | Run `context.mjs` and `next.mjs --run RUN`. Return snapshot from actual files: `architecture_ready`, `tasks` (including `execution`), `observation_id`, `completed_since_audit` from progress.json, and structured `resume` from next. Run `failure.mjs --action summary --target TARGET` and return its compact `failure_state`; these are causal histories, not acceptance or model-routing proof. Architecture is ready only with full original-requirement mapping and valid contract, not a placeholder file. Return WAIT/BLOCKED honestly. Derive `repair_attempt` (zero-based) from saved implementation receipts when resuming later repair rounds.                                                                                                                |
| checkpoint-architecture                                     | Validate all task/check coverage with context.mjs and preserve Opus long plan; transition ARCHITECTURE→PLAN.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| plan                                                        | Select dependency-ready task with task.mjs --action select; preserve its execution on resume. Write short sprint contract. If payload.resume exists for this exact task, inspect/reconcile that exact operation, then use task.mjs select with `--resume true` to retain the selected execution/provenance; preserve partial product and enter REVIEW/VERIFY rather than IMPLEMENT. Without a valid structured resume, do not reuse a different execution merely to keep an old approval. Return snapshot with the selected execution.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| checkpoint-failure                                          | Preserve the actual non-PASS result and call `failure.mjs --action record --target TARGET --run RUN --attempt ROOT_ATTEMPT --task TASK --id REQUEST_OPERATION_ID --input FILE`. Input includes `stage` (implementation/review/test), `category`, original `status/summary`, requested `model`, a concrete `hypothesis`, `experiment`, `next_step`, and `evidence_refs` (`name/sha256` for existing evidence). Categories distinguish implementation, review, test, repeated_fix, design, environment, model_limit, permission, terminated, evidence. Do not invent a cause when unknown: state the uncertainty and an executable diagnostic experiment. This journal is not proof of actual model routing. Return refreshed failure_state from the CLI.                    |
| diagnose                                                    | Inspect repeated failures and logs, test a different root-cause hypothesis and repair strategy. Call `failure.mjs --action strategy` with ownership/task/id and input containing concrete `hypothesis/experiment/next_step`, requested Sonnet model and optional existing hashed evidence refs. Identical prior hypothesis+experiment is rejected. Preserve every failed check; do not merely reword the same tactic.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| persist-review / persist-final-review / persist-final-audit | Independently returned assessment must include v2 `status`, snapshot `product/contract/identity/session/run/task/attempt`, `task_ids`, `executions`, original requirement refs and actual findings. Collect/import the actual runtime observation, then use assessment.mjs to save verbatim. It refuses stale snapshots and mismatched version/kind/scope. A successful save is coordinator PASS even when the assessment itself is NEEDS_FIX; the Workflow evaluates that decision separately. Missing runtime proof remains UNVERIFIED. Set `snapshot.blocker_scope="global"` only for a global outage; task-specific evidence failure can defer that task and continue independent work.                                                                                |
| close-task                                                  | Execute task.mjs --action complete. Return PASS only if its actual task gate passes; never set backlog PASS by hand. Review scope/task execution and all acceptance reports must be current. Return snapshot including persisted progress.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| checkpoint-audit                                            | Save real Opus milestone assessment, then run progress.mjs to reset completed_since_audit only after a valid PASS/NEEDS_FIX audit. This maintains cadence across repeated one-sprint bursts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| replan-milestone / replan-final-review / replan-final-audit | Apply concrete independent findings to the long/short plan; use task.mjs --action reset on affected tasks. Preserve the original mission. Reset creates a fresh execution ID, invalidating old task approvals even if source returns to identical bytes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| replan-final-verification                                   | Read actual failed check IDs/reports, map to tasks and reset them with task.mjs. Return PLAN and continue implementation. Missing environment evidence is not a code repair; record exact blockers instead of repeating the same final check forever.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| defer-or-replan                                             | Preserve task blocker/failure and Opus recommendations. Missing tools, model limits, permissions, terminated processes and missing evidence are external blockers: attempt the specific recovery, otherwise defer without an irrelevant code redesign. An actual new Opus replan must be saved with `failure.mjs --action strategy` (model claude-opus-5-5, changed hypothesis and experiment); it opens a new Sonnet repair window while retaining all previous failures. Four failed rounds trigger investigation rather than permanently ending development. If unresolved, mark just this task BLOCKED with task.mjs and continue dependency-ready independent tasks. Revisit it only with a new hypothesis or changed external evidence. Do not remove it from scope. |
| prepare-final-gate                                          | Confirm current task/check/requirement coverage and final assessments, all current execution IDs, all operation results. If verification changed product/contract after final assessment, require a fresh review/audit. Transition through AUDIT→IDLE while owner remains active. Parent must wait for actual Workflow completion, save SDK terminal+drained proof, `state end`, then execute independent verify. Never call this COMPLETE.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

Every result is JSON with `status`, `summary`, `findings`, and optional `snapshot`. Preserve the actual independent result in payload; a status with zero findings still matters. Resolved findings can remain in history with `resolved:true`; unresolved major/critical findings forbid PASS.

`/goal` is the outer continuation mechanism. On CONTINUE_PARENT, read current context again, update Workflow `observation_id` to the actual observation hash, and relaunch the same mission. Stable implementation receipt IDs use task/execution/repair-round; fresh inspector prompts use observation_id so runtime cached responses cannot masquerade as current filesystem observations. Never reuse a stale observation_id after external edits/recovery.

## Bounded handoff and long-running recovery

`failure.json` is an optional additive v2 causal journal. Old missions start with no events; prior evidence is never promoted to PASS by migration. Failure history is mission/task scoped and retains execution/run/session IDs across owner/session changes. `failure_state` returns two recent events, the latest strategy, cause, next experiment and requested next model; do not reread every old log at every sprint. Relevant test selection belongs to the sprint contract; final verification still refreshes every mandatory check.

After two code-repair failures, use Sonnet diagnosis and implementation. After four, use Opus to change the technical hypothesis or defer this task. An explicit design contradiction returns to Opus immediately. Environment/quota/permission failures remain in total history but do not consume code-repair escalation rounds. A genuinely new Opus strategy opens another elevated repair window; it does not erase failures or shrink the mission. Missing runtime capability is not a failed code experiment. If every independent task is externally blocked, save exact recovery instructions and let the parent report BLOCKED; `/goal` cannot create model access, approve permissions or start a new cloud session by itself.

On forced termination before a failure result was saved, the parent must first obtain genuine terminal+drained proof, reconcile partial edits, and record the interruption as category `terminated` with the actual next diagnostic step. Never treat an absent result as a successful call. Reopen blocked work only after a new causal strategy or changed external evidence is observed.

A read-only review/audit is always preceded by a fresh coordinator inspection in the Workflow. Return the actual full context (product/contract/identity, mission/session/run/task/attempt, selected executions and requirement refs); never reuse a plan snapshot after implementation. The deterministic inspection sequence identifies distinct reads, not acceptance evidence. If initial planning was interrupted before contract publication, the parent finishes the native burst and recovers the root, then uses repair-plan.mjs with terminal proof; retain and read the archived draft. Do not reset a published plan as an initial draft. Backlog task ID mission is reserved for the parent root; preserve requirement IDs via requirement_refs.

Readonly interruption is a separate continuation basis: native reviewers have no writer receipt. When next returns recovery_kind=READONLY, inspect retained product, frozen stopped-root state/proof/raw and any completed implementation receipt. Do not call operation.observe on a completed or absent receipt. Select with `--resume true --observed_fingerprint ACTUAL_CURRENT_HASH --reason ACTUAL_INSPECTION_REASON`; this preserves task execution and restarts REVIEW/VERIFY, with changed code returning to REVIEW. An INTERRUPTED writer still uses operation.observe. Each completed/reset task clears its own continuation. Finish overdue persisted milestone audits before the next task; checkpoint-audit must return persisted completed_since_audit=0 or stop as UNVERIFIED instead of repeatedly spending Opus calls.

This is executed by the real Sonnet parent/coordinator with Bash/Read/Edit/Write. The JS Workflow has no filesystem API. Read the `AUTODEV_REQUEST` object and preserve every CLI error. Parent supplies the run lease before launch. `run_id/attempt_id` in this request identify that lease; selected backlog `execution.attempt_id` can differ and binds task reviews/model logs.

Before any write, `operation.mjs --action start --run RUN --attempt ROOT_ATTEMPT --task TASK --id REQUEST_OPERATION_ID --stage STAGE --target TARGET`. STARTED permits the action; ALREADY_APPLIED returns the saved result after inspecting current files; OBSERVE_REQUIRED forbids blindly applying edits. Complete with `--action complete --result JSON_FILE`. `inspect` is a read and does not create a writer receipt. An interrupted receipt is preserved; after actual diff inspection use `operation --action observe` with JSON containing `observed_fingerprint` and `reason`. ## Bounded handoff and long-running recovery

`failure.json` is an optional additive v2 causal journal. Old missions start with no events; prior evidence is never promoted to PASS by migration. Failure history is mission/task scoped and retains execution/run/session IDs across owner/session changes. `failure_state` returns two recent events, the latest strategy, cause, next experiment and requested next model; do not reread every old log at every sprint. Relevant test selection belongs to the sprint contract; final verification still refreshes every mandatory check.

After two code-repair failures, use Sonnet diagnosis and implementation. After four, use Opus to change the technical hypothesis or defer this task. An explicit design contradiction returns to Opus immediately. Environment/quota/permission failures remain in total history but do not consume code-repair escalation rounds. A genuinely new Opus strategy opens another elevated repair window; it does not erase failures or shrink the mission. Missing runtime capability is not a failed code experiment. If every independent task is externally blocked, save exact recovery instructions and let the parent report BLOCKED; `/goal` cannot create model access, approve permissions or start a new cloud session by itself.

On forced termination before a failure result was saved, the parent must first obtain genuine terminal+drained proof, reconcile partial edits, and record the interruption as category `terminated` with the actual next diagnostic step. Never treat an absent result as a successful call. Reopen blocked work only after a new causal strategy or changed external evidence is observed.

A read-only review/audit is always preceded by a fresh coordinator inspection in the Workflow. Return the actual full context (product/contract/identity, mission/session/run/task/attempt, selected executions and requirement refs); never reuse a plan snapshot after implementation. The deterministic inspection sequence identifies distinct reads, not acceptance evidence. If initial planning was interrupted before contract publication, the parent finishes the native burst and recovers the root, then uses repair-plan.mjs with terminal proof; retain and read the archived draft. Do not reset a published plan as an initial draft. Backlog task ID mission is reserved for the parent root; preserve requirement IDs via requirement_refs.

Readonly interruption is a separate continuation basis: native reviewers have no writer receipt. When next returns recovery_kind=READONLY, inspect retained product, frozen stopped-root state/proof/raw and any completed implementation receipt. Do not call operation.observe on a completed or absent receipt. Select with `--resume true --observed_fingerprint ACTUAL_CURRENT_HASH --reason ACTUAL_INSPECTION_REASON`; this preserves task execution and restarts REVIEW/VERIFY, with changed code returning to REVIEW. An INTERRUPTED writer still uses operation.observe. Each completed/reset task clears its own continuation. Finish overdue persisted milestone audits before the next task; checkpoint-audit must return persisted completed_since_audit=0 or stop as UNVERIFIED instead of repeatedly spending Opus calls.
